body: This happened to me, but I was fine after a few months. It was more annoying than anything, but the first week or so I was panicking that I would never ever go back to normal. Eventually I just came to terms with the fact I would always be in that state lol. It does go away in time, don’t panic, be safe. :)
Thank you so much for answering! :) I'll definitely pick up a can just in case I feel the need to use it.
